**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/22 (Mon) 14:37
- [EVENT] User is looking for advice on how to properly wash their Nike Dri-FIT running socks.
- [FACT] User has been using their Nike Dri-FIT running socks for about 6 months.
- [FACT] User has been using the socks non-stop for morning jogs.
- [FACT] User purchased new Asics Gel-Kayano shoes last month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide on how to wash the Nike Dri-FIT socks effectively.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Before washing, check the care label and turn the socks inside out.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wash the socks in cold water (below 30°C or 86°F) with mild detergent.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Hand wash or use a gentle cycle with a mesh laundry bag.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Add a 1/2 cup of white vinegar to the wash cycle or soak the socks in a vinegar solution (1 part vinegar to 2 parts water) for about an hour before washing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Air dry or tumble dry on low to prevent shrinkage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wash socks every 3-5 wearings to prevent odor buildup.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Store socks in a well-ventilated area or in a mesh bag when not in use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Consider using an odor-controlling spray for additional freshness.
